device: Tuna EMULATED HDR10 qualification sink; not physical hardware or a shipping kernel module
licensing: Upstream per-file SPDX GPL-2.0+ retained; Makefile GPL-2.0-only. Added driver/probe GPL-2.0+. Complete upstream GPL-2.0 and Linux-syscall-note retained with COPYING.
scope: Separate module/platform/DRM name tuna_hdr_vkms; stock vkms is never replaced or unloaded
Exact synthetic EDID explicitly names TUNA EMU HDR / TUNA EMU SDR

Real upstream GEM shmem/atomic/vblank/frameflip/u16 composition/writeback; virtual-sink and writeback encoders explicitly advertise mutual cloning of their one composed CRTC, including both self bits, before DRM registration
Real XR30 and AR30 ten-bit read and write conversions; no eight-bit truncation
HDR admission in kernel requires active ten-bit primary, BT2020_RGB, max requested bpc10 and PQ/type1 metadata

Root connected sysfs parameter models a real virtual cable; connector detect plus canonical single-connector HPD helper updates kernel connection status/epoch and emits actual DRM hotplug uevents; lifetime mutex prevents events against torn-down device
Unplug/replug keeps the same registered connector and exact EDID; no compositor state overrides; kernel mode/EDID cache clearing follows normal master reprobe
No fake compositor flags, capability overrides or policy relaxation
FBdev console registration removed so emulated qualification module does not take host consoles

runtime_recipe.headers: Exact running kernel headers, present in pinned official cloud image. Both generated UTS_RELEASE and include/config/kernel.release must equal the running kernel before external-module build; actual built module name/vermagic are checked immediately after build and again before load. No host kernel replacement or ABI override.
runtime_recipe.guest_prerequisite_coherence: Immutable official archive matching the authenticated image era, including Noble updates/security/backports. Noble APT normally uses By-Hash but can fall back to mutable index filenames even with force; snapshot paths remove that mirror-sync race. No acquisition retry, ignored update error, disabled signature/hash/Valid-Until check, kernel replacement, or relaxed ABI guard.

observed_header_abi_failure.sequence: Immutable signed 20261018T000000Z APT prerequisites installed successfully; the installer then rejected standalone make kernelrelease output 6.8.12 against actual running kernel 6.8.0-147-generic before module compilation.
observed_header_abi_failure.cause: Ubuntu's packaged Makefile VERSION/PATCHLEVEL/SUBLEVEL describe upstream base 6.8.12, not Ubuntu ABI 6.8.0-147-generic. Without M=, kernelrelease calls scripts/setlocalversion and recomputes that upstream base. External-module Kbuild instead reads the packaged include/config/kernel.release, while generated UTS_RELEASE supplies module vermagic.
observed_header_abi_failure.limit: The failed guest retained package identities and running kernel but not generated-header contents. Matching local packaged headers were researched read-only; their contents are not represented as direct guest evidence. The earlier reported localhost preflight and this failed guest preparation were not rerun to confirm them.

observed_writeback_routing_failure.failure: tuna-hdr-probe: real composed writeback commit: Invalid argument
observed_writeback_routing_failure.routing_contract: The first writeback request attaches the previously unbound writeback connector to the active CRTC. update_connector_routing sets connectors_changed, which requires DRM_MODE_ATOMIC_ALLOW_MODESET. A fresh signed-image TCG run with that flag still failed; the flag is necessary but not sufficient.
observed_writeback_routing_failure.root_cause: Noble 6.8.0-147 additionally validates possible_clones for every encoder sharing a CRTC. The upstream v6.8 VKMS driver leaves both clone masks zero; DRM registration normalizes each to its own self bit, so virtual-sink plus writeback routing is rejected. guest-kernel.log from /tmp/colour-hdr-atomic-proof-20261102 records actual atomic driver -22 immediately after affected planes and before encoder bridges, matching the exact Noble clone-validation stage. This is real kernel EINVAL, separately confirmed after fixing the probe's errno masking.
observed_writeback_routing_failure.driver_correction: After successful writeback encoder initialization, set both encoders' possible_clones to the union of their masks. Both really consume the same composed CRTC output. Do not skip or modify the core clone validator, HDR admission, formats, pixels, fences or negative atomic controls.
observed_writeback_routing_failure.diagnostic_correction: Atomic commit syscalls preserve their real errno instead of using require(), which overwrites errno. The guest runner retains guest-kernel.log even when the selftest receipt cannot be produced; diagnostic collection cannot prevent retention of proof artifacts.
observed_writeback_routing_failure.adaptation_scope: The locally authored userspace probe and adapted vkms_output.c change. upstream-adaptation.patch contains the exact additional clone-mask hunk against the original pinned v6.8 source; upstream source hashes are unchanged.

private_seat_endpoint.cause: Noble seatd 0.8.0-1 hardcodes /run/seatd.sock in both seatd and seatd-launch, contrary to the launcher's documented dedicated-socket description. It has no socket-path option; starting the launcher beside the package-started service fails.
private_seat_endpoint.implementation: Optional ci-install-hdr-vkms run --seatd starts only its own seatd daemon in a private mount namespace with the fresh endpoint state directory bound to /run. The compositor remains in the ordinary guest namespace and connects through SEATD_SOCK to state-dir/seatd.sock. The daemon signals readiness through an inherited pipe. Command/daemon process groups, private socket and module are cleaned on success/failure/signals. The existing system service/socket is neither stopped nor unlinked.
private_seat_endpoint.guest_contract: Both HDR and unsupported endpoints request --seatd. Retained endpoint receipts must record seatd_stopped=true and seatd_socket_removed=true in addition to the existing successful command/module cleanup requirements.
private_seat_endpoint.runtime_limit: Private-seat lifecycle and complete HDR/unsupported compositor payload require parent execution after its coherent build. The preceding corrected-module run proves the kernel component only.

evidence_limits: The corrected module/probe completed the actual kernel selftest in /tmp/colour-hdr-clones-proof-20261102, with exact JSON/raw hashes recorded above. The overall guest remained FAIL at subsequent seatd-launch startup, so its aggregate and native compositor/capture qualification are not claimed. The new private-seat lifecycle requires the parent's complete payload run.
identity operation and property presence alone are not proof of HDR production output.

selftest proves real kernel XR30 pageflip/writeback/metadata and invalid-commit rejection; native compositor FP16 render, display configuration, screencast, restart and unsupported-output journeys must run separately inside the same endpoint.
snapshot reads actual active primary GEM, not composed writeback; kernel selftest separately proves the writeback path.

Live hotplug source/control/probe are implemented; actual native output/global/calibration removal, return and new-frame evidence must be observed in the pinned guest proof, not inferred from a sysfs write or fabricated unknown state.
Virtual HDR code values and metadata cannot qualify physical panel or link fidelity. Physical qualification is outside EMULATED device claims.
